operations.description: The source reports that using urea as fuel gives slightly larger 23 nm YAG:Ce nanocrystals, lower quantum yield and more sintering. Exact alternate charges, temperature/time schedule and physical batch identity are not provided. This is one alternative, not a mixture of both comparison fuels.
